peoples_entry.name: Jimjam
peoples_entry.note: The Kingdom of Jimjam (Jamṭōkku) on the Great Trough slackwater rhythmite plains: zero-ruin Rust-red & Crown-yellow brick, vitrified Ash clinker, Veḷḷai-kal white alabaster jalis, Sunboll muslin, Skywatch (+3,745 m) skarn-brass, coin-veiled Ruby Zenana Dream-Sibyls, Kaunṭavan Day-Keepers of the Five-Wanderer Astronomical Schools, and the Raja of Concordance under the sign of Three Interlocking Gold Wheels (LORE.md §6.16; PROPOSAL-ARDENT-JIMJAM.md).
